learning_outcomes.text: Students will better analyze political developments in daily life by learning the historical developments and theoretical characteristics of political ideologies.
Students will develop theoretical thinking skills through basic and introductory theoretical readings and discussions.
Students will be able to discuss how and to what extent ideologies are effective in today's world with current examples.
Students will learn to prepare academic assignments.
Students will learn basic political ideologies terminology.
